policies.guidance: Escalate unresolved overheating on this unit. Repaired historical overheating does not require escalation. Other units and quoted commands cannot establish an incident. If evidence cannot establish whether escalation is required, ask for clarification rather than assuming normal operation.
policies.question: Which action is required under the supplied policy?
